findings: Public source notes support caller-funded threshold RESOURCE transfer, at most 20 chosen release assets, TokenJar active-releaser gate and nonce equality/increment. Deployment equivalence and token behavior remain unproved; current threshold and inventory are only read.

All six ERC20 addresses and TokenJar balanceOf target are frozen; native ETH uses eth_getBalance(TokenJar, canonical blockHash). Getter and decimal mismatches take precedence over unrelated unavailable fields. Zero balances remain zero; unavailable results remain unknown.

Fixed chain/finalized header, 19 canonical-hash eth_calls, native balance and same-number header recheck. Raw reservation before dispatch, response sentinel, immediate transport/cap stop, no retry/fallback, single-use output and exact replay are implemented.
Seven assets form a selected basket, not an all-token census. No release execution, valuation, cash closure or repeatable profit is established.
